html:
Here is a shot of M44 taken on the night of March 12-13, 2008 around 10:30. It is a stack of 30 photos of 60 sec at ISO 800 with 30 darks and 15 flats. Stacking in Nebulosity under Mac OS X.5
Camera: Canon EOS Rebel xti
Lens: Soligor 135mm F2.8 at F4.5
Site: Grand-Mère
Mount: Alt-Az ( rotation is obvious at the edge of the photo)



I received the wedge needed for equatorial alignment of the LX90. The next sessions will be devoted to polar alignment of the telescope in order to eliminate field rotation in photos longer than 30 seconds.

I also need to improve the way I take flats. For now I use my computer screen (50% gray screen) with a sheet of paper taped over the screen as the light source.
